title: Regulatory affairs manager, latam & brazil responsável técnico
description:
Confira a vaga para Regulatory affairs manager, latam & brazil responsável técnico em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At Genesis Med Tech, our quest is to make quality healthcare accessible for everyone. We believe each of us can make a positive impact at work. Together we explore ideas, innovate new solutions and make great things happen. Our culture is built on collaboration and a shared commitment to make an impact on the lives of our patients. Position Overview We are seeking a LATAM Regulatory Affairs Manager & Brazil Responsável Técnico (RT) to join our team. This is a critical strategic role responsible for leading the regulatory roadmap across Latin America. The successful candidate will act as the primary bridge between Global Headquarters and local markets, driving efficient market access for Class III/IV surgical devices. Additionally, this role serves as the legally designated RT for the Brazil subsidiary, with responsibility for quality compliance and legal accountability. Key Responsibilities 1) Regional Strategic Leadership (LATAM) Market Access Roadmap: Develop and execute regulatory registration strategies for key markets, including Brazil (ANVISA), Colombia (INVIMA), Mexico (COFEPRIS), Argentina (ANMAT), and Chile (ISP). Regulatory Reliance: Leverage Brazil's IN 290/2024 and similar reliance pathways in Colombia and Mexico to accelerate approvals using FDA, PMDA, or EU MDR data. Distributor Oversight: Audit and manage third-party distributors across LATAM, ensuring compliance with global quality standards in storage, traceability, and post-market surveillance. External Partner Management: Supervise regional regulatory consultants to ensure adherence to project timelines and technical accuracy.  2) Brazil Legal Accountability (RT Functions) Statutory Responsibility: Act as the officially registered Responsável Técnico (RT) with ANVISA and the professional council (CREA). QMS & BPF (GMP) Maintenance: Establish and maintain the Quality Management System in accordance with RDC 665/2022; lead ANVISA inspectionsand CBPF certification renewals. Technical Advocacy: Manage INMETRO certification processes for active devices (e. G., robotics and energy-based systems), including coordination of technical peer reviews of international IEC 60601 reports. Vigilance: Oversee the Technovigilance system, including adverse event reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCA) across the region.  Requirements Bachelor's degree in Biomedical, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering. Active and valid CREA (Conselho Regional de Engenharia) registration in Brazil is required. Minimum of 10 years of experience in Medical Device Regulatory Affairs, including at least 3 years in a regional LATAM leadership role. Fluent in English and Portuguese, with professional working proficiency in Spanish. Proven track record with Class III/IV (High Risk) devices. Experience with surgical robotics or energy-based surgical systems is highly preferred. Experience managing MDSAP audits and ANVISA BPF certifications Ability to balance commercial objectives with legal and technical independence Skilled in translating complex regulations into business insights; effective in navigatingthe high-stakes legal environment of being a designated RT.  About Genesis Med Tech WE MAKE BETTER HEALTHCARE HAPPEN. This is our quest: to make quality healthcare more affordable and accessible. Headquartered in Singapore, Genesis Med Tech shares a bold new world of value-based healthcare across surgical, cardiology and vascular interventional specialities. With an open platform that brings the best of medtech together from every corner of the globe, we disrupt the inefficiencies and fragmentation that keep quality healthcare out of reach for many. Genesis Med Tech aims to become the most scalable, efficient and transparent business platform for the medtech industry. At Genesis Med Tech, we are also actively growing our product portfolio through R& D and innovation, acquisitions, as well as partnerships with strategic startups. Website:  Genesismedtech. Com/

title: Senior business intelligence analyst
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business intelligence analyst em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will play a critical role in supporting business performance through advanced analytics focused on Sales and Revenue. This position will partner closely with Sales Leadership and Finance to deliver insights, ensure accuracy in key processes such as pricing and commissions, and drive data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role requires a high level of ownership, business acumen, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Key Responsibilities Own and continuously improve sales and revenue reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness Manage and govern the Price Book, including updates, validations, and alignment with commercial strategies Lead the end-to-end process for sales commissions, including calculation logic, validation, and reporting Partner with Sales leadership to analyze performance, trends, and key drivers of revenue Translate business needs into data models, dashboards, and actionable insights Act as a business partner to Sales and Finance, supporting strategic and operational decisions Ensure data integrity and governance across systems and reporting tools Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and scalability in reporting workflows Support financial and accounting-related reporting in a matrix structure (secondary responsibility) Proactively challenge assumptions and bring insights to improve business outcomes  Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field Strong experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or related roles Strong experience in sales analytics, revenue reporting, and performance tracking Hands-on experience with sales commissions and pricing structures (highly preferred) Advanced Excel skills (mandatory) Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar) Strong understanding of data structures and reporting logic Experience working in cross-functional and international environments is a plus  Key Competencies Strong business acumen, especially in Sales and Revenue processes High level of ownership and accountability Ability to operate with ambiguity and shifting priorities Strong stakeholder management skills (ability to influence without authority) Attention to detail with a strategic mindset Clear and effective communication across all levels of the organization  Scope & Impact Primary focus: Sales Revenue, Reporting, Price Book, and Commissions Secondary support: Accounting / Financial reporting (matrixed) High visibility role with direct interaction with Sales and Finance leadership Critical to ensuring accuracy in revenue-related processes and decision-making  Location & Work Model Remote (Brazil-based), CLT contract São Paulo market reference

title: Analista de novos negócios junior | vendas
description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de novos negócios junior | vendas em indaiatuba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Na Groways atuamos com uma venda consultiva e de qualidade ofertando serviços de marketing digital. Em nosso momento estamos buscando pessoas com experiência em vendas para agências digitais ou vendas de alto ticket. Nosso time de vendas não possui separação entre SDR e Closer, ficando o vendedor responsável por toda a cadeia, desde a triagem até o fechamento do cliente. Entendemos que esse é o melhor formato para o nosso modelo de negócio. O seu dia a dia será composto de atividades como: - Reuniões para entendimento de necessidades (briefing) online; - Elaboração de propostas comerciais; - Agendamento de reuniões online para apresentação de propostas; - Negociação e fechamento com o cliente; - Abertura de novas contas na agência junto ao time operacional; - Gestão da sua carteira de clientes, intermediando conflitos ou alinhamentos necessários; - Ocasionalmente,realizar prospecção de novos clientes. Alguns requisitos (eliminatórios) para a vaga: - Necessário o domínio de CRM de vendas e processo de vendas consultivo; - Habilidades para lidar com negociações e suas objeções. ***IMPORTANTE***: Somente candidatos que atendem a esses requisitos seguirão no processo. Conhecimentos e experiências que podem fazer a diferença (mencione isso em sua entrevista ou currículo): Experiência em agências digitais; Conhecimento em marketing digital ou suas especialidades; Conhecimento de CRM; Experiência de uso do Meetime para ligações. Salário: R$2.100,00 + Comissão. Benefícios: Vale-refeição; Seguro de vida; Auxílio Home Office; Day off no dia doaniversário. Outras informações: O sistema de contratação para esta vaga é o CLT. Requisitos Conhecimento de CRM básico Habilidade de Comunicação Avançado Prospecção Intermediário Negociação Intermediário Vendas Intermediário

title: Médico plantonista de terapia intensiva pediátrica. hospital são luiz são bernardo - rede d ́or;
description:
Nova oportunidade para Médico plantonista de terapia intensiva pediátrica. hospital são luiz são bernardo - rede d ́or; em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Descrição da Empresa A Rede D' Or São Luiz é a maior operadora hospitalar do Brasil, presente em estados como Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Distrito Federal e Pernambuco, com mais de 20 unidades hospitalares. Fundada em 1977, a instituição segue em expansão contínua, contando com mais de 4.000 leitos e uma equipe altamente qualificada de 28 mil profissionais. A rede se destaca não apenas como empregadora, mas como uma organização que valoriza a inovação e oferece oportunidades para profissionais fazerem a diferença em suas áreas. Venha fazer parte do maior grupo hospitalar do país e contribuir para o cuidado com a saúde de milhares de pessoas. Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Médico Plantonista de Terapia Intensiva Pediátrica para atuar em nosso hospital em São Bernardo do Campo, SP. O profissional será responsável por oferecer atendimento de alta qualidade e humanizado em nossa unidade de terapia intensiva pediátrica. Entre as atividades, estão realizar avaliações médicas, implementar planos terapêuticos e acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes. Este é um cargo presencial, sob regime de plantão e com contrato formal. Qualificações Habilidades Técnicas: Formação completa em medicina com RQE em pediatria (Obrigatório) e em terapia Intensiva Pediátrica (Desejável) Experiência: Experiência comprovada em UTI pediátrica e capacidade de realizar procedimentos de urgência/emergência. Habilidades Interpessoais: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação com equipes multidisciplinares, pacientes e familiares, além de empatia no atendimento pediátrico. Necessita certificação específica em suporte avançado de vida (PALS)

description:

title: Customer service representative
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer service representative em capão da canoa. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Customer Service Representative   Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)   Job Type: Full-Time   Love helping people and solving problems fast?  We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.  About Uproot Clean   Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.  Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.  The Role   This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.  You are  not  just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.  This Role Is For You If:   You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently  You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions  You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly  You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip  You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved  You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment    This Role Is NOT For You If:   You avoid dealing with difficult customers  You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality  You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms    What You'll Do   Customer Support Execution   Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms  Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale  Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice    Social Media Support   Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok  Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency    Order & Refund Management   Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges  Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed    Conflict Resolution   Handle complaints with empathy and clarity  Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions    Cross-Functional Collaboration   Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams  Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations    Requirements   Must have:    Experience in customer service  (ecommerce or DTC preferred)   Strong  written communication skills in English   Experience  handling social media interactions is a strong plus   High  attention to detail and ability to multitask  Comfortable  working in fast-paced environments    Work Requirements   ⏰  Schedule:  Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST   Workspace:  Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)  Benefits & Compensation    Fully remote  - work from anywhere in LATAM.   Paid time off    Flex days.  Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire   Ownership & autonomy  - trusted to build and execute strategy  Professional development  - opportunities to learn and grow with the business    Ready to Apply?   If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day. About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Customer service representative
description:
Confira a vaga para Customer service representative em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative   Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)  Job Type: Full-Time   Love helping people and solving problems fast?  We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.  About Uproot Clean   Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.  Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.  The Role   This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.  You are  not  just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.  This Role Is For You If:   You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently  You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions  You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly  You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip  You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved  You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment    This Role Is NOT For You If:   You avoid dealing with difficult customers  You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality  You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms    What You'll Do   Customer Support Execution   Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms  Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale  Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice    Social Media Support   Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok  Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency    Order & Refund Management   Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges  Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed    Conflict Resolution   Handle complaints with empathy and clarity  Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions    Cross-Functional Collaboration   Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams  Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations    Requirements   Must have:    Experience in customer service  (ecommerce or DTC preferred)  Strong  written communication skills in English   Experience  handling social media interactions is a strong plus   High  attention to detail and ability to multitask  Comfortable  working in fast-paced environments    Work Requirements   ⏰  Schedule:  Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST   Workspace:  Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan) Benefits & Compensation    Fully remote  - work from anywhere in LATAM.   Paid time off    Flex days.  Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire   Ownership & autonomy  - trusted to build and execute strategy  Professional development  - opportunities to learn and grow with the business    Ready to Apply?  If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Remote bookkeeper
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote bookkeeper em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A  Income Tax Plus Inc  é um escritório profissional de contabilidade localizado em Framingham, Massachusetts, especializado em  bookkeeping, contabilidade, preparação de impostos e relatórios financeiros  para pessoas físicas e empresas. Nosso foco é oferecer serviços financeiros de alta qualidade, com precisão, organização e atendimento personalizado. Sobre a Vaga   Estamos em busca de um(a)  Bookkeeper / Auxiliar Contábil  para atuar em regime  presencial e tempo integral  . O(a) profissional será responsável por manter registros financeiros precisos, apoiar operações contábeis diárias e colaborar com a equipe de contabilidade e impostos. Buscamos alguém organizado, detalhista e com experiência prática em rotinas contábeis.  Responsabilidades   Manter registros financeiros organizados e atualizados  Preparar e revisar  demonstrações financeiras    Lançar e reconciliar journal entries (lançamentos contábeis)   Trabalhar com softwares contábeis  (ex.: Quick Books, similares)  Garantir conformidade com normas contábeis e financeiras  Auxiliar nos processos de  preparação de impostos (tax preparation)  Apoiar as operações financeiras e administrativas do escritório     Qualificações    Experiência em  bookkeeping, contabilidade e lançamentos contábeis    Conhecimento em financeiro, conciliações e relatórios contábeis    Domínio de softwares de contabilidade (Quick Books é um diferencial)   Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de organização    Conhecimento em impostos nos EUA  é um diferencial   Graduação em Contabilidade, Finanças ou área relacionada (preferencial) Boa gestão de tempo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe  Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% remoto     Por que trabalhar na Income Tax Plus Inc   Vaga estável em tempo integral  Ambiente profissional, colaborativo e respeitoso  Oportunidade de crescimento na área contábil e fiscal  Experiência prática com clientes individuais e empresariais    Interessados podem se candidatar diretamente pelo Linked In ou entrar em contato conosco para mais informações.

title: Customer service representative
description:
Confira a vaga para Customer service representative em boituva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day. About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day. About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day. About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

description:

Customer Service Representative Location: Fully Remote (LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time Love helping people and solving problems fast?We're looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability. Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth. The Role This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses. You arenotjust answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand. This Role Is For You If: You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly You pay attention to details and don't let things slip You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment This Role Is NOT For You If: You avoid dealing with difficult customers You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms What You'll Do Customer Support Execution Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice Social Media Support Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Tik Tok Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency Order & Refund Management Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed Conflict Resolution Handle complaints with empathy and clarity Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions Cross-Functional Collaboration Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations Requirements Must have: Experience in customer service(ecommerce or DTC preferred) Strongwritten communication skills in English Experiencehandling social media interactions is a strong plus Highattention to detail and ability to multitask Comfortableworking in fast-paced environments Work Requirements Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)Benefits & Compensation Fully remote- work from anywhere in LATAM. Paid time off Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire Ownership & autonomy- trusted to build and execute strategy Professional development- opportunities to learn and grow with the business Ready to Apply? If you care about delivering great customer experiences and want to be part of a fast-moving team, apply now.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud operations engineer em piracicaba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Eightpoint Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love. About the Role The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams. Key Responsibilities Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure. Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling. Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners. Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation. Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime). Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform. Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones. Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures. Who You Are5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role. Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front). Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker). Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions. Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA. Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting). Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python). Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence). Preferred Qualifications Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services. Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro). Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms. AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer). Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging. Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

Who We Are:  We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions. Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.    Who We’re Looking For:   Professional experience working in data warehousing, data architecture, and/or data engineering environments, especially using spark, hadoop, hive etc with solid understanding of streaming pipelines.  Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language (Scala, Java, Python or equivalent) Good understanding of databases  You have built large-scale data products and understand the tradeoffs made when building these features  You have a deep understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms  You have an excellent knowledge of distributed computing frameworks such as Hadoop Map Reduce, Spark  You have a strong knowledge of following AWS infrastructure - EMR, S3, Lambda, Redshift etc  You have strong understanding of data quality, governance  You are a team player, self-driven, highly motivated individual who loves to learn new things    Join Our Global Team:  We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus  Equal Opportunity Employer:  We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

description:

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.  Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.   Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.  SOBRE A VAGA     A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.  Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!  Neste papel você será responsável por processar atividades rotineiras de departamento pessoal, realizar gestão de benefícios e atendimento de colaboradores das unidades de Salvador (4 escolas).   RESPONSABILIDADES     O que você fará:   Rotinas de DP:   Admissões;  Demissões;  Gestão de jornada (controle de ponto eletrônico e manual);  Controle de férias;  Folha de Pagamento.  Gestão de Benefícios (plano de saúde, plano odontológico, vale transporte, vale refeição/alimentação):   Inclusão;  Exclusão;  Alteração.  Conferência de NFs para pagamento:   Controle e envio de pagamentos de RPA (Autônomos);  Atendimento aos colaboradores (presencial e online).  Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.  REQUISITOS     O que você precisa ter:   Graduação em andamento ou completa em Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou áreas afins;  Excel intermediário ou avançado (procv, tabela dinâmica);  Experiência mínima de 02 anos em Departamento Pessoal.  Será um diferencial se você tiver:    Experiência com BPO (folha terceirizada - Sistema Totvs RM Labore);  Inglês intermediário.  Você vai se encaixar bem se conseguir:   Ser organizado(a) para realizar acompanhamento e gestão das suas atividades;  Ter bom relacionamento e jogo de cintura para ter contato com pessoas de diferentes níveis de senioridade/hierárquicos.  DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA     O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.  Visit our careers site for more information;  #LINK

JOB DESCRIPTION    Aqui na Construtora  Tenda  , nosso propósito é claro: desafiar o impossível para que mais pessoas conquistem o seu lugar no mundo  . Por isso, todas as nossas vagas também são destinadas a profissionais com deficiência (Pc D), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente plural, respeitoso e colaborativo.  Agora queremos te contar mais sobre a vaga de Pessoa Recrutadora  na área de Gente & Gestão  e como você pode construir o futuro junto com a gente.  #Vem Pra Tenda  RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS    Conduzir os processos de Atração e Seleção voltados especificamente para as necessidades das diretorias de operações, assim contribuindo para a otimização contínua das práticas e políticas de RH, tendo como objetivo aumentar a atratividade da empresa, reduzir a rotatividade e melhorar a retenção de colaboradores, alinhando as estratégias de RH às necessidades específicas dos projetos e operações da construção civil. Buscar e desenvolver parcerias para anunciar as vagas, com o objetivo de ampliar a captação de candidatos qualificados para o perfil das vagas;  Contribuir no aprimoramento dos roteiros de entrevistas, bem como pareceres e aplicação de dinâmicas de grupo.  Conduzir Dinâmicas de Grupo, Entrevistas e aplicação de casos de negócio/ testes, avaliando o perfil dos candidatos versus as competências exigidas para a vaga;  Acompanhar e garantir os indicadores de tempo e qualidade dos processo de sua atuação, gerando possíveis processo de acompanhamento e melhoria continua e eficiência do processo;  Acompanhar e executar projetos pontuais relacionados ao processo de Atração e seleção, para contribuir com o planejamento/crescimento do negócio;  Contribuir que as políticas de Atração bem como as que impactam na área estejam atualizadas e alinhadas as práticas;  Contribuir com as soluções de melhorias nos processos e sistemas, alinhando as necessidades de eficiência do processo bem como atendimento do negócio;  Ser o guardião das premissas e políticas de Gente & Gestão, e da cultura avaliando os comportamentos desejados do jeito de ser Tenda. Atuando como um multiplicador e com uma visão consultiva. Sobre a vaga    Esta posição será o ponto focal e vai liderar os assuntos relacionados as questões de tributos indiretos (ICMS/IPI/PIS/COFINS/ISS/ Retenções), assumindo uma um papel de parceiro(a) do negócio, efetuará a revisão de ICMS/IPI nos 5 Estados que operamos, bem como a revisão de PIS/COFINS de duas entidades legais. Nesta posição de Líder de Impostos Indiretos você irá    Revisar a apuração de ICMS/IPI nos 5 Estados que operamos;  Revisar a apuração de PIS/COFINS de duas entidades legais;  Atuar como revisor das apurações dos analistas plenos e júniores;  Garantir a entrega no prazo das obrigações acessórias e pagamento de impostos;  Efetuar a manutenção das tabelas da J1 BTAX e Vertex;  Prover suporte técnico a área de negócio das operações fiscais;  Preparar e revisar as conciliações contábeis das contas referentes a impostos indiretos e retenções;  Prover suporte a área de Tax corporativo;  Participar do processo de implementação da reforma tributária;  Atender fiscalizações na esfera estadual, federal e municipal;  Revisar os processos e procedimentos da companhia;  Elaborar projetos de recuperação de créditos fiscais;  Elaborar controle do crédito acumulado e plano para compensação;  Liderar e desenvolver o time de indiretos;  Participar do projeto da reforma tributária.  É preciso que você tenha    Superior completo preferencialmente em Ciências Contábeis;  Imprescindível forte experiência anterior com tributos indiretos para indústria;  Mínimo de 7 anos de experiencia na área fiscal;  Experiência com SAP;  Inglês avançado para escrita e conversação;  Mobilidade para trabalhar presencialmente na cidade de Jundiaí/SP.  Será um diferencial se você tiver    Experiência com projetos para a Reforma Tributária;  Registro ativo no CRC;  Experiência com o sistema Guepardo;  Experiência com o sistema Vertex.  Acreditamos que você seja/tenha    Excelente capacidade analítica e de influenciar pessoas, boa comunicação, ótimo relacionamento interpessoal, capacidade de administração de demandas e goste de trabalhar com autonomia.  Se interessou?    Esta é uma posição efetiva em período integral, para trabalhar presencialmente na cidade de Jundiaí/SP, reportando-se para Gerente Contábil/Fiscal.  Por favor, candidate-se através do nosso sistema de recrutamento online. Não aceitaremos candidaturas via e-mail. Assim que sua candidatura estiver conosco, analisaremos se suas qualificações e experiência são aderentes ao perfil requerido para a função!  Estamos ansiosos por sua candidatura!  Pedimos a gentileza aos nossos candidatos internos, que se inscrevam com seu e-mail Nouryon, através do Success Factors. Nossos colaboradores são motivados pelo desejo de causar impacto e impulsionar ativamente mudanças positivas. Se isso te descreve, teremos prazer em dar espaço para suas ambições. Desde o primeiro dia, apoiamos o seu crescimento pessoal, através de desafios, oportunidades abrangentes de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento, em um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, internacional, diversificado e proativo.  Visite nosso e nos siga no.  #We Are Nouryon #Grow With Us   (#LI-Onsite)  ***

title: Assistente de logística
description:
Nova oportunidade para Assistente de logística em itaquaquecetuba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

O Assistente de Logística será responsável por apoiar as operações diárias do setor logístico, garantindo que os processos de recebimento, armazenamento e distribuição de produtos sejam realizados de forma eficiente e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos. As principais atividades incluem:- Recebimento de mercadorias: Conferir as notas fiscais e a quantidade de produtos recebidos, garantindo a conformidade com os pedidos realizados e registrando eventuais divergências.- Armazenagem: Organizar os produtos no estoque de acordo com as normas de armazenagem, utilizando adequadamente os espaços disponíveis e garantindo a segurança e a integridade dos itens.- Controle de estoque: Monitorar os níveis de estoque, realizando inventários periódicos e atualizando o sistema com informações precisas sobre entradas e saídas de mercadorias.- Separação de pedidos: Preparar os pedidos para envio, garantindo que os produtos corretos sejam selecionados e embalados adequadamente, de forma a evitar danos durante o transporte.- Expedição: Auxiliar na organização das rotas de entrega, preparando a documentação necessária e conferindo os caminhões antes da saída, assegurando que todos os procedimentos logísticos sejam seguidos rigorosamente.- Comunicação: Interagir com fornecedores, transportadoras e outros setores da empresa para resolver problemas e otimizar o fluxo de operações logísticas.- Relatórios: Elaborar relatórios mensais sobre o desempenho das atividades logísticas, oferecendo insights que possam contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos. O profissional deverá atuar com proatividade, atenção aos detalhes e ter boa habilidade em trabalhar em equipe, sempre buscando soluções para eventuais desafios que surgirem. É desejável conhecimento em softwares de gestão logística e a capacidade de lidar com prazos apertados, mantendo a qualidade no trabalho.Cargo: Assistente de LogísticaTipo de Contrato: TemporárioÁrea profissional: LogísticaCarga-horária: 220Número de vagas: 1Benefícios: VT + Seguro de Vida + Refeiçãono localRequisitos: Para a posição de Assistente de Logística, é essencial ter uma compreensão sólida dos processos logísticos e da cadeia de suprimentos. O candidato ideal deve possuir conhecimentos básicos em planejamento e controle de estoques, gestão de transporte e distribuição, além de familiaridade com rotinas administrativas pertinentes ao setor. Experiência anterior em empresas de logística, transporte ou comércio pode ser um diferencial, especialmente no que diz respeito ao manuseio de documentos fiscais e notas de entrega. O profissional deve ter habilidade em realizar lançamentos e controle de dados em sistemas de gestão, garantindo a eficácia nas operações.É desejável que o Assistente de Logística tenha noções sobre a legislação relacionada ao transporte e à armazenagem de produtos, visando a conformidade das operações. Conhecimento em ferramentas de informática, como Excel, sistemas ERP e softwares de gestão logística são fundamentais para otimizar processos e garantir a agilidade nas atividades diárias.Além das competências técnicas, o profissional deve demonstrar habilidades interpessoais, como boa comunicação, trabalho em equipe e proatividade, sendo capaz de lidar com prazos e demandas variadas. A capacidade de resolver problemas e a disposição para aprender continuamente são características valorizadas, uma vez que o setor logístico está em constante evolução.O Assistente de Logística também pode ser envolvido em atividades de coordenação entre diferentes departamentos, ajudando na coordenação de recebimentos e expedições. É importante que o candidato possua uma boa visão analítica e esteja atento aos detalhes, garantindo que os processos aconteçam de forma fluida e eficiente.Por fim, um interesse genuíno pela área e a disposição para enfrentar desafios são características que devem estar presentes no perfil do profissional. A oportunidade oferece um ambiente dinâmico, onde será possível desenvolver habilidades e crescer na carreira dentro da logística.VT + Seguro de Vida + Refeição no local

A atuação está conectada à cadeia de Logística / Supply Chain, com foco em execução operacional, controle do fluxo dos pedidos, interface com fornecedores e suporte à continuidade da operação.  A pessoa será responsável por acompanhar o processo de compras ponta a ponta, desde a identificação da necessidade até a entrega final, garantindo que os pedidos sejam processados corretamente, dentro dos prazos, volumes e condições já definidas. É uma função voltada para quem tem perfil analítico, organização para lidar com alto volume de demandas e habilidade para transitar entre diferentes áreas e parceiros, contribuindo para a eficiência e a conformidade da operação.  Esperamos uma pessoa com experiências correlatas que podem ser em compras, abastecimento, logística, supply chain ou outras rotinas operacionais, que tenha boa capacidade analítica, organização e senso de prioridade para acompanhar um alto volume de pedidos e demandas simultâneas, garantindo execução correta, visibilidade do fluxo e alinhamento entre fornecedores e áreas internas. Precisa ter facilidade para atuar com controles, planilhas, sistemas e interfaces diversas, com atenção a prazos, compliance e detalhes operacionais, contribuindo para a continuidade do abastecimento e para a fluidez da operação. title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em ribeirão preto. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Reboot Monkey   Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents  . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide.  We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  About the Role   Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.  As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania  , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician  . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try.  This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT  or managed DCTs directly  . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management.  What You'll Do   Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region   Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords   Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score   Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history   Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria   Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training   Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team   Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region   Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them   Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings    Requirements   3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)   Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills   Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring   Fluent written and spoken English   Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision   Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Compliance specialist, compliance & communications
description:
Empresa está contratando Compliance specialist, compliance & communications em osasco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Compliance Specialist to join the Compliance & Communications team within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role supports compliance oversight across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs, ensuring that partners operate in accordance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements. In this role, you will assess partner compliance, develop scalable audit mechanisms, drive a compliance culture across our network, and generate actionable insights through structured reporting. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about compliance, risk reduction, and making a meaningful impact, come join our team. Key job responsibilities- Conduct partner audits across Amazon Partner Logistic programs to verify compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements - Develop and maintain audit execution plans, tracking compliance scores, non-conformities, and corrective action plans - Generate structured compliance reports including audit adherence, action plan adherence, and operational standards adherence - Investigate non-compliant partner activity and prepare audit reports with findings and recommendations - Develop scalable compliance mechanisms: SOPs, written guidance, training programs, and internal review processes - Deliver audit findings to partners and coordinate with internal teams (Legal, Operations, Procurement) on corrective actions - Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on Last Mile operations - Identify compliance gaps, root causes, and practical recommendations to mitigate risks proactively - Maintain accurate records of audit activities, compliance status, and follow-up actions - Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the overall compliance programA day in the lifeYour day starts by reviewing the compliance monitoring queue: checking flagged partner activities, pending audit follow-ups, and opening corrective action items across Partner Logistics programs. Later, you lead a call with a partner to walk through audit findings, discussing non-conformities and aligning on a corrective action plan. You update the audit execution report with scores, compliance status, and next steps. Then, you collaborate with Legal and Operations to refine a compliance SOP and review the weekly adherence dashboard: tracking audit adherence rates, action plan completion, and operational standards performance across the network. Every day brings a mix of investigation, stakeholder engagement, process building, and data-driven reporting.About the teamThe Compliance & Communications team is part of Amazon Logistics’ Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMXL (Amazon Extra Large), and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate in full compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. We develop scalable audit mechanisms, generate actionable compliance insights, and drive partner engagement through strategic communications. The team sits within a broader Strategic structure that also covers Pricing, Payments & Incentives, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross-functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS    - Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent- Experience handling confidential information- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities- Experience working with a cross functional team- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbalPREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS    - Experience in SQL data manipulation- Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques- Experience working in risk/fraud analysis or in compliance organizations- Experience in logistics- Experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems- Experience creating training programs or compliance communication materials

This role owns the execution and continuous improvement of pricing models and incentive programs across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). In this role, you will analyze partner pricing structures, design and track incentive programs, conduct benchmarking studies, and generate actionable insights through structured reporting. You will report directly to the Pricing & Incentives, Payments & Disputes Manager and work cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an AMZL office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, data-driven decision-making, and building scalable pricing mechanisms, come join our team. Key job responsibilitiesAnalyze and maintain pricing models across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL partner programs, ensuring rate structures are competitive, consistent, and aligned with business objectives Design, execute, and monitor incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to identify gaps, opportunities, and recommendations for rate adjustments Build and maintain structured reports and dashboards tracking pricing competitiveness, incentive adoption, ROI, and program performance Develop scalable pricing and incentive mechanisms: SOPs, written guidance, simulation models, and governance frameworks Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to validate pricing proposals and align incentive structures with contractual frameworks Investigate pricing anomalies, cost deviations, and incentive program inefficiencies, preparing analyses with findings and recommendations Monitor changes in market conditions, regulatory requirements, and operational dynamics that may impact partner pricing or incentive structures Identify process improvement opportunities to increase pricing accuracy and incentive program effectiveness Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the overall pricing and incentive strategy A day in the lifeYour day starts by reviewing the pricing and incentives monitoring queue: checking flagged rate deviations, pending incentive calculations, and open action items across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL partner programs. You update the pricing review report with benchmarking data, rate comparisons, and next steps. After lunch, you collaborate with Operations and Procurement to refine an incentive program SOP, then review the weekly performance dashboard: tracking incentive adoption rates, ROI metrics, and pricing accuracy across the network. You close the day by running a simulation model for a new incentive structure, analyzing different scenarios and preparing a data-backed recommendation for the next team review. Every day brings a mix of analytical deep-dives, stakeholder engagement, process building, and data-driven reporting — all in service of ensuring Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive and sustainable economic frameworks.About the team

JOB DESCRIPTION    UMA EMPRESA BRASILEIRA, FEITA DE TALENTOS, PAIXÃO, MUITO ENTUSIASMO E DESAFIOS!   Oi, somos aVAMOS  ! Um ecossistema único em alternativas para a renovação e expansão da frota brasileira. Com isso, desenvolvemos nosso negócio diariamente em cima de dois pilares: renovar e inovar, contribuindo sempre para melhorar a performance e aumentar a rentabilidade dos nossos clientes.  Nossa jornada é movida pela responsabilidade com cada CLIENTE  , pelo comprometimento com a nossa GENTE  , pela SIMPLICIDADE  do Nosso Jeitão de ser e realizar, pela ATITUDE DE DONO  em nosso dia a dia, assegurando a SUSTENTABILIDADE  em tudo o que fazemos e tendo o LUCRO  como garantia da renovação dos nossos ciclos.  Buscamos pessoas que apresentam simplicidade, paixão por servir e que tenham interesse em aprender, desafiar-se e desenvolver-se junto ao crescimento da empresa. Se você tem esse perfil e quer trabalhar em um local em que a nossa Gente faz a diferença, confira nossas vagas ou cadastre seu currículo em nosso banco de talentos.  Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela VAMOS   são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios.  RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS    Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Financeiro Pleno com perfil proativo, boa capacidade analítica e excelente habilidade de comunicação para integrar o nosso time! Se você gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem jogo de cintura para contornar objeções e sabe como manter o #Jeitão no relacionamento com clientes, essa vaga é para você.  Realizar e acompanhar cobranças com foco em negociação e bom relacionamento com o cliente;  Lidar com objeções de forma estratégica, sempre mantendo uma abordagem empática e profissional;  Manter contato direto com clientes, utilizando uma comunicação clara e eficaz;  Apoiar nas rotinas financeiras da área, como conciliação e controle de recebíveis;  Participar de fechamento financeiros, com disponibilidade para eventuais prorrogações de horário;  Utilizar Excel em nível intermediário para relatórios e análises financeiras;  Colaborar com outras áreas, mantendo sempre o bom clima e relacionamento interpessoal.  REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS    Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;  Conhecimentointermediário em Excel(proc V, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos, etc.);  Habilidade de comunicação com o cliente (verbal e escrita);  Facilidade em lidar com objeções e negociações;  Bom relacionamento interpessoal e espírito colaborativo;  Disponibilidade para trabalhar até mais tarde em dias de fechamento;  Fácil acesso à região de Mogi das Cruzes.  .  ADDITIONAL INFORMATION    Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além:  Clube de benefícios:  Plataforma exclusiva com descontos em diversas categorias - gastronomia, entretenimento, serviços, educação, lazer e esporte.  Ligado em você:  canal com atendimento especializado para você e sua família, com suporte psicológico, social, financeiro, jurídico e muito mais, disponível 24 horas, com total sigilo.  Licença Maternidade  e Paternidade estendidas, além de um  Kit nascimento  para recém-mamães e recém-papais.  Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na VAMOS  , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar  para os filhos da nossa gente.   Universidade VAMOS  , plataforma para o seu autodesenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.  Evento Veteranos:  reconhecemos celebramos nossa Gente veterana, com eventos especiais para quem completa mais de 15 anos de casa.  Cantinho da Mamãe:  O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno.  No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.   Totalpass:  para você cuidar da sua qualidade de vida, saúde e bem-estar.  ﻿Kit escolar  com preços acessíveis (para você garantir materiais de qualidade e com custo benefício.  Pet Love:  Para cuidar também do seu filho de quatro patas, incluímos um benefício especial para mais esse membro da sua família  Quem Somos    Ficamos felizes de te ver por aqui!   Na VAMOS, acreditamos que gente é o nosso maior diferencial. Somos um ecossistema que transforma o transporte e a mobilidade com inovação, simplicidade e propósito — tudo isso pautado em valores sólidos, alinhados aos pilares de ESG e, agora, fortalecidos pelo nosso novo olhar estratégico: SIM+PAR  .  O SIM+PAR  representa a forma como queremos avançar em 2026:  SIM  de simplificar, somar e seguir juntos.  PAR  de parceria, protagonismo e propósito.  É essa combinação que impulsiona nossas decisões, nossa cultura e nossa forma de fazer — sempre com foco no que realmente importa: as pessoas.  Aqui, você encontra oportunidades reais de crescimento, desenvolvimento e protagonismo. Trabalhamos com a inclusão de grupos sub-representados e valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Nossas vagas são para todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Queremos talentos que compartilhem nossa paixão pelo cliente, nosso foco em resultados e nossa vontade de construir o futuro com simplicidade e colaboração.  Nossos valores nos movem:   • Cliente  : É a razão da nossa existência.  • Gente  : É o que nos torna únicos.  • Simplicidade  : Ser simples para ser ágil.  • Atitude de dono  : Se fosse meu, eu faria melhor.  • Sustentabilidade  : Cada atitude conta.  • Lucro  : É missão de todos — para crescer e seguir inovando.  E agora, com o SIM+PAR  , reforçamos nossa ambição de fazer ainda mais e melhor: agir com propósito, fortalecer parcerias, acelerar movimentos e construir, juntos, um ecossistema cada vez mais humano, eficiente e conectado.  Se você acredita que pode fazer a diferença e quer construir sua jornada em um ambiente colaborativo, seguro e cheio de oportunidades, VAMOS juntos e juntas  . Porque aqui, gente é o nosso negócio  .

SOBRE A VIBRA    Com presença nacional e exportações para mais de 70 países, através das marcas Nat e Avia,   reunimos tradição e inovação para produzir o melhor da proteína de frango.    A qualidade dos produtos do nosso portfólio é o resultado da nossa cultura de excelência, do controle rigoroso de um processo que vai das nossas granjas aos supermercados  . É também fruto da nossa experiência na avicultura e produção de alimentos.    Em 2020, firmamos uma joint venture com a Tyson Foods  . A Vibra está agora, lado a lado com uma das maiores produtoras de proteína animal do mundo. A parceria cria oportunidades de ampliar e desenvolver novos mercados  , sendo referência no segmento  .   Juntas, Vibra e Tyson Foods, expandem seu alcance global, levando produtos inovadores e de qualidade para ainda mais consumidores.  Com sede em Montenegro/RS,   onde também encontra-se o seu Centro de Inovação Vibra (CIV)  , considerado o primeiro centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de produtos do seu segmento no estado, a empresa tem operações no Rio Grande do Sul  , Paraná e Minas Gerais   e uma unidade de negócios em Dubai.   Entre nossas unidades somamos mais de 5.000 colaboradores e contamos com a parceria de mais de 900 famílias de produtores integrados.   /nFormação  :   Superior em andamento Logística, Administração, Comércio Exterior e áreas afins;    Desejável:    Pacote office;  Experiência com gestão de faturas;  Conhecimento de legislação fiscal;  Pró-atividade, inovação, visão sistêmica, disposição, trabalho em equipe, curiosidade, capacidade de comunicação.   /nAcompanhamento e Ajuste na Programação do frango vivo e ração;  Monitoramento Carregamento e Chegada dos Veículos;  Informação de Disponibilidade Frota da Primária;  Lançamento de fretes por pedidos;  Lançamento de CT-e complementares de frete;  Informação de Disponibilidade Frota da Primária;  Preenchimento Painel da Gestão.
